description: This file defines the TaskRepository class, providing an interface for managing Task objects, including creating, updating, deleting, and observing tasks through a local data store.

classes.name: TaskRepository
classes.description: A repository class providing methods to manage tasks, backed by a LocalTaskStore.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Factory method to instantiate TaskRepository with a LocalTaskStore using provided context.

methods.name: observeTasks
methods.description: Returns a Flow that emits the list of all tasks, sorted by completion status and recency.

methods.name: observeTask
methods.description: Returns a Flow that emits updates for a single task identified by id.

methods.name: addTask
methods.description: Adds a new task with given title and description, returning the new task's id.

methods.name: updateTask
methods.description: Updates the task identified by id with new title, description, and completion status.

methods.name: deleteTask
methods.description: Deletes the task identified by id.

methods.name: toggleCompleted
methods.description: Updates the completion status of the task identified by id.
